Subject: Region & deployment arbitration: MAP milestone review

Hi Sophie / Acme team —

Following our demo last week, attaching a first-draft Mutual Action Plan and security summary. We want to lock the deployment mode + region decision in the next two weeks so procurement and infra can align timelines. High-level asks:

- Confirm preferred region for initial POC (us-east / eu-central)
- Indicate whether you require a Dedicated/reserved capacity commitment for go-live or if starting on Hosted is acceptable for the POC
- Any SSO/KMS constraints that would push toward Private

Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
1) POC kickoff (week 1) — hosted in chosen region, basic data residency config
2) Eval & perf window (weeks 2–4) — perf targets and cost targets
3) Contract + reserved capacity decision (week 5) — Dedicated vs Hosted SLAs
4) Cutover plan / production runbook (weeks 6–8)

Please review the attached MAP_v1.xlsx for task owners and acceptance criteria. If you'll share the procurement timelines we can map to our Dedicated provisioning lead times.

Thanks,
Jordan

Redwood Inference

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the plan. A few constraints from our side:
- Data residency: primary requirement is EU (we need data to remain in EU for the POC and production)
- Procurement: Finance expects a cost estimate and commitment window by end of June; they may prefer a reserved contract if price delta is beneficial
- Security: SOC2 + detailed data flow diagram required for contract signing

For the POC, starting on Hosted in an EU region is acceptable so long as we have documented KV/data isolation and can move to Dedicated later without significant rework. Can you provide a short note that outlines the migration path from Hosted->Dedicated (timeline + estimated downtime)?

Sophie

Thanks for the context — I updated the MAP and sketched a migration path. Summary below; updated files attached (MAP_v2.xlsx, Mutual_Action_Plan.md):

Recommendation (short):
- Start POC on Hosted in eu-central to satisfy data residency and speed up kickoff.
- During POC (weeks 1–4) run perf tests and vet quantization/latency with our Optimize suggestions.
- At decision gate (week 5) evaluate: if 95th-pct latency and cost targets are met, continue on Hosted with a 6–12 month contract and opt for burst/dedicated pool reserve for predictable throughput; if not, provision Dedicated reserved capacity (eu-central) with a 2–3 week lead time for GPUs and a planned maintenance window for cutover.
- Private deployment: only if mandated by compliance (HITRUST/contractual data segregation), typically H1 next year once we have a dedicated on-prem integration plan.

Migration path Hosted -> Dedicated (short):
1) Pre-provision Dedicated pool (2–3 weeks lead) in eu-central
2) Confirm model variant parity (quantization + kernels) in staging
3) Re-route traffic via smart routing (no app changes) with gradual % shifting (canary) over 2–4 hours
4) Finalize cutover and decommission hosted resources; expected customer-visible downtime during canary is negligible, planned P99 spikes may occur during sync windows and will be mitigated by dual-write cache

Action items for Acme:
- Confirm EU region and preferred contract cadence (monthly vs annual)
- Share procurement deadlines and SSO/KMS requirements
- Review attached MAP_v2 and sign-off on acceptance criteria
